parametrized_description: A chemical company uses two tests, a salinity test and a pH test. Each unit of the salinity test requires ProbesSalinity probes. Whereas each unit of the pH test requires ProbesPH probes. The chemical company must perform at least MinPHTests pH tests. In total, at least MinTotalTests tests must be performed. Further, because of the importance of the salinity test, there must be at most MaxPHSalinityRatio times more pH tests than salinity tests. How many times should each test be performed to minimize the total number of probes used?

MinPHTests.description: Minimum number of pH tests to be performed

MinTotalTests.description: Minimum total number of tests to be performed

MaxPHtoSalinityRatio.description: Maximum ratio of number of pH tests to salinity tests

NumSalinityTests.description: Number of salinity tests to perform

NumPHTests.description: Number of pH tests to perform

constraints.description: At least MinPHTests pH tests must be performed
At least MinTotalTests tests must be performed in total
The number of pH tests must not exceed MaxPHtoSalinityRatio times the number of salinity tests
The number of salinity tests is non-negative
The number of pH tests is non-negative

objective.description: Minimize the total number of probes used in both salinity and pH tests
